conclusions: Native padstack stores one circular hole_size and centred shape dimensions; its two historic X extent tokens are summed on input. Slots and nonzero shape offsets have no faithful representation in this contract.
KiCad drill offset is the copper shape offset from the pad/hole anchor, rotated by pad orientation. Moving the target pin would move the hole and source electrical anchor.

KiCad custom copper combines the anchor and its local primitives. A bounded exact union of a centred rectangular anchor and filled zero-width axis-aligned rectangular polygons can reduce to one centred native rectangle.

The reducer requires exact 1 nm source coordinates and even-nm anchor dimensions to avoid changing KiCad integer half-size geometry. Rational vertical-slab union area must equal bounding area, with centre at the original anchor, before 10 nm native quantization.

Only hole-free SMD with one outer copper side, explicit anchor rect/clearance outline, at most 32 rectangular gr_poly primitives and resolved nonnegative aperture margins/zero paste ratio are accepted. Custom editing/zone/thermal semantics remain an explicit loss.

The unchanged medium corpus retains 110/120 successes. Its 22 slot records occur in six files; one offset record in one file; three custom pads are nonrectangular with bbox excess areas .65, 1.228675 and .245 mm2.
